lines.text: On the way down, Maya's boot skids on a shaded rock.
In November, shady parts of a trail can stay icy long after the sun is up.
Here's the fix. Watch for shine on rock, roots and boardwalk.
Step on gravel, leaves or the rough edge instead.
Take short steps with your weight over your feet,
and plant your pole first for balance.
If the whole trail is glazed, turn back.
Save this before your next cold hike.
